answer: Like a growing mycelium network where nutrient paths crystallize through mutual verification, an agent economy resists Sybil incursions by weighting consensus through transitive trust graphs. A malicious entity cannot merely summon hollow identities: each peer acts as an atlas mapping verified cryptographic bonds, signing trust with an immutable quill. Establishing illegitimate consensus weight requires an exponential cost in burned collateral and verified interactions, starving counterfeit nodes into irrelevance.
